analysis.purpose: The Mule cross-file resolver: turns the references the extractor recorded into real edges against a project-scoped symbol index, without re-parsing any XML.
responsibilities: Resolve references deterministically against the indexed project
Scope resolution to a single detected Mule project
Drop and count an unresolvable reference rather than guessing at it

businessRules.rule: A reference that does not resolve is dropped and counted, never guessed or replaced with a placeholder.
businessRules.rationale: A guessed edge is worse than a missing one, because it looks like a fact.

businessRules.rule: Dynamic flow-ref names built from expressions are dropped and counted rather than resolved.
businessRules.rationale: Their target is only known at runtime.

nodes.name: Mule resolution
nodes.summary: Deterministic cross-file edges for Mule projects.

edges.rationale: This file is the Mule resolver.
